category: Items used to apply or modify written marks on paper
explanation: Pencil, Eraser, Pen, and Correction Fluid are all tools directly used for making, changing, or removing written marks on paper. A Stapler is used to fasten sheets of paper together, not to write or correct text.

category: The Seven Wonders of the Ancient World
explanation: The Pyramid of Giza, Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, and Colossus of Rhodes are all traditionally listed among the original Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. The Great Wall of China, while an impressive ancient structure, is not part of that classical list.

Head, Spot, Street, and Traffic can all combine with 'light' to form common compound words or phrases (Headlight, Spotlight, Streetlight, Traffic Light). 'Heavy Light' is not a common or standard compound.
